summary.text: Joe Luneau is a Republican state representative from Franklin-3 who has served in the Vermont House of Representatives since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Suzanne Kenyon.
He is a justice of the peace.

paragraphs.text: Joe Luneau was born in St. Albans, Vermont, and earned a bachelor's degree from Boston College.
His career experience includes working as a justice of the peace.
Luneau assumed office on January 8, 2025, succeeding Mike McCarthy, and advanced from the Republican primary on August 11, 2026.
